obligations.summary: Independent factory instances publish one stable/current descriptor; progressive format claims are a subset of formats and require constructible ProgressiveImageDecoding sessions.
All 2304 finite capability requests, including format-specific progressive delivery, agree with an independent membership oracle and exact failure precedence.
Every advertised encoded format is probed deterministically and agrees with the descriptor format claim.
Every advertised encoded format decodes a reference still image into bounded deterministic output geometry.
Backend resource estimates are deterministic and positive while conservative host composition preserves both lower bounds.
Encoded-byte, format, dimension and pixel hard limits fail closed with stable ImageCraft errors.
